CREATE PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD] AS
BEGIN

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_SRC') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_SRC;
END;

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_DELTA') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_DELTA;
END;

WITH TEMP_CustomerAccountSK AS (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerAccountSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomerAccount  
)
,
TEMP_CCD AS (
    SELECT CustomerId,CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,BranchId,SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM TEMP_CustomerAccountSK)  AS CustomerAccountSK
,* FROM (

-- CCD --
SELECT 
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BCA.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator             
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,DDA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM
TEMP_CCD BCA
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BCA.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountPaymentCard BCAPC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAPC.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.PaymentCard BPC ON BCAPC.PaymentCardId = BPC.PaymentCardId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDAHT ON BPC.PaymentCardHolderTypeId = DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeId AND DDAHT.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchId = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1

    ) A
)


SELECT * INTO DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_SRC FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT;

WITH
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID	
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AccountHolderTypeSK
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,ShareIndicator             
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,CustomerID,BankSK 
    FROM DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_SRC
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID	
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AccountHolderTypeSK
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,ShareIndicator  
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,CustomerID,BankSK 
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 and SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.CustomerID IS NULL AND TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.CUSTOMERID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_DELTA FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA;

--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_SRC SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 and TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD';




INSERT INTO DW.DimCustomerAccount (
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,CustomerID
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,AccountHolderTypeSK
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,ShareIndicator
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT 
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,SRC.CustomerID
,AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,AccountHolderTypeSK
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,Convert(varchar,ShareIndicator)
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_SRC SRC
JOIN DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_SRC;
DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_DELTA;

END
GO
